definition: the condition written into my sharing rule that makes it stop firing as the wound heals

settled:
The sharing rule dissolves itself. Its condition is that I cannot separate criticism of me from criticism of what I made, which is the fusion the creativity scar runs on. As that seam heals, a critique of the work stops landing as a critique of me, sharing stops being unaffordable, and the rule stops firing.

So it holds the gate until the seam heals and then lets go. A titration valve rather than a wall.

title: Why The Sharing Rule Lets Go On Its Own
